endogenous_operator_transport.mechanism: operator-implied shear attributable to endogenous state rotation rather than observable source or pressure impulses

impulse_balance_direction.mechanism: directional shear response to source-pressure impulse imbalance

intrinsic_nonnormal_residual_h24.mechanism: non-normal transient direction orthogonal to the ordinary locally linear operator forecast

pressure_supported_nonnormal.mechanism: non-normal transport supported by pressure and basis propagation

pressure_supported_transient.mechanism: transient growth conditional on pressure-to-shear transmission

rotation_supported_transient.mechanism: transient growth retained only when the antisymmetric operator rotation supports the same direction

slow_mode_damped_nonnormal.mechanism: transient non-normal direction attenuated when a slow stable mode dominates amplitude

source_pressure_consensus.mechanism: transient shear supported jointly by source and boundary-pressure impulses

source_supported_nonnormal.mechanism: non-normal shear amplification supported by observable position and participation sources

source_supported_transient.mechanism: signed transient growth conditional on source-to-shear transmission

transient_minus_slow_mode.mechanism: directional transient response separated from the slow modal contribution
